meta.parties: Valiappa Chettiar v. Suppiah Pillai Et Al

rules.statement: A warrant of attorney to confess judgment is invalid if the proctor attesting it was not expressly named by and attending at the request of the person executing the document.
rules.supporting_quote: "One important requirement in this section is that the proctor must attend 'on behalf of the defendant'. There are authorities under the similar enactment in 1 & 2 Victoria, c. 110, relating to warrants of attorney and cognovits."
